name: linear-vs-nonlinear
$comment: The nonlinear cup (left, blue box) next to the same cup with the nonlinear bellows off (right, sand box) on the vertical bounce: the lift stroke, the bottoming and the stiffer, safer hold.

annotations.text: One bellows suction cup (nonlinear bellows) on a tool with a prescribed motion holds a box. motion: 1 hold, 2 vertical bounce, 3 horizontal steps, 4 tilt swing, 5 lateral chirp. Mon draws the cup in 3D and latches a drop; Trans demodulates the lateral chirp.

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: Centre of mass offset from the box centre, x

parameters.name: F_min
parameters.description: Residual friction capacity of a free lip

parameters.name: s_bot
parameters.description: Compression stroke before the folds bottom (estimate)

parameters.name: x_bot
parameters.description: Reference over-stroke of the bottoming law

parameters.name: A_fold
parameters.description: Folded bellows annulus: vacuum lift stroke A_fold*dp/k_ax (estimate)

parameters.name: c_vac
parameters.description: Lateral/tilt stiffness rise with vacuum, 1 + c_vac*dp/p_atm (estimate)

parameters.name: c_ext
parameters.description: Lateral/tilt stiffness fall with extension, exp(-c_ext*ext/L0) (estimate)

parameters.name: Q_max
parameters.description: Ejector suction flow at zero vacuum (free air)

parameters.name: perm
parameters.description: Air permeance of the box surface

parameters.name: motion
parameters.description: Excitation: 1 hold, 2 vertical bounce, 3 horizontal steps, 4 tilt swing, 5 lateral chirp

parameters.name: fsc
parameters.description: Frequency scale of the chirps and the fast swing

parameters.name: T_ring
parameters.description: Bounce: free ring-down before the chirp

parameters.name: a_s
parameters.description: Steps: largest acceleration (moves at a_s/3, 2a_s/3, a_s)

parameters.name: th_B
parameters.description: Swing: amplitude of the fast swing

parameters.name: f_sw
parameters.description: Swing: frequency of the fast swing

parameters.name: N_sw
parameters.description: Swing: cycles of the fast swing

parameters.name: t_lift
parameters.description: Lift start (the vacuum is on from t = 0)

parameters.name: T_exc
parameters.value: 1*max(0, 1 - abs(motion - 1)) + (T_ring + T_cz + 0.6)*max(0, 1 - abs(motion - 2)) + (6*T_p + 6*T_c + 0.3)*max(0, 1 - abs(motion - 3)) + (2*T_sw + T_h + 0.8 + N_sw/(fsc*f_sw))*max(0, 1 - abs(motion - 4)) + (T_cx + 0.6)*max(0, 1 - abs(motion - 5))
parameters.description: Length of the excitation window (per motion)

parameters.name: pen0
parameters.description: Rest penetration of the box corners in the table

parameters.name: z0
parameters.description: Start height of the cup mount (lip on the box top)
